QuestInfo.name: Book Learning
QuestInfo.0: Help Cygnus become a proper Empress.
QuestInfo.1: You need a textbook to build common sense and knowledge. Neinheart suggested you hit up #b#p2520021##k.\r\n#b(Talk to Kiriru to go to Minar Forest.)#k

0.0: This season's goal is to teach the basic common sense and knowledge needed to become Empress. We'll need an appropriate textbook.
0.1: You'll find a dragon named #bNix#k hiding in Minar Forest. Just mention my name and he will know what to do.

yes.0: The Airship is just above. Safe travels to you.\r\n#b(Talk to Kiriru near the Airship to go to Minar Forest. Find Nix when you get there.)#k

no.0: We absolutely need this book for Cygnus.

1.0: *Cough cough* What's big idea? You could have knocked instead of barging in with a whole airship!\r\n#L0##bI've come from Ereve for a book.#l\n#k
1.1: What, from Ereve? How did you know I have...THAT book?\r\n#L0##bNeinheart said you did.#l\n#k
1.2: #bNeinheart#k? Ah, that bookworm from Rien? I DID have a talk with him a few weeks back. Probably one of the smartest humans I've met. He did mention a #bcandidate for Empress#k...\r\n#L0##bYes, we found a candidate.#l\n#k

yes.0: #b(Nix suddenly glances around.)#k\r\nSh. We can't say such things out loud. No one must know that Ereve is without an Empress.
